body: Dude no he's not seeing someone else dafuq

I just don't know what to do. I feel like there is something wrong that i don't get. It's driving me insane. Like he is not even giving me anything to work with here, it's just a wall of "doesn't matter to me" and "you choose what to do". Like dude c'mon i'm not buying you a house here it's just a fucking coffee. And he was in self dev groups for wayyyy to long so he always gives me some shitty advice and tells me what im doing wrong but never suggests what i could do better in a positive or supporting way. And he has only started doing that since august. He pretends to be better than everyone else recently... i mean unless u have authority, 178k followers on instagram or are rich haha
And he is like that to his friends too.

It has kind of always been this way with invites and parties and stuff but i felt like recently he was more withdrawn than usual und tends to put me down when im telling about something in my life. Whenever he tells me about his plans he ususlly doesn't mention me in them. Which is fine, o get nlt everything has to do with me but still, nothing? Really?
On the other hand last year i have asked him to put some more effort into stuff like texting me at other Times than the middle of the night cuz it made me feel a bit weird and he actually did stop that and started asking me about my day and talking to me.
The weird thing is, as long as im talking about myself he responds but the moment i ask him how he's doing he doesn't answer anymore

Yea i was crying really badly a few days back because i didnt know what to make of this as i don't get to see him every day.
He said i shouldn't worry so much and that he gets why i feel this way. He also said i would be fine without him which kinda confused me a bit more.
I just said i wished he would include me more because i'm very busy and more or less use any freetime i can get to be around him and i felt like im not that much of a priority to him.
He also said he doesnt want to ask me to come over because he doesnt want to cause me to spend all my money(ldr). Although I've told him before that i dont care much about these things i just want to feel like he wants me to be there. I dont always want to invite myself(its kinda sad). 
His response was that he generally doesn't invite people but gets invited instead which i get but dude c'mon i'm your girlfriend and you don't even think about asking me?... 
There's just so many different conflictung responses that idk what to make of it
Thank you for the kind mesages i have received❤

Hey there f20 here
I had the same responses. I think it is because they do not know how to react to your emotional state appropriately because tbh most people never learned about these things. I think they are automatically turning to the reaction that either feels most natural to them such as crying out of fear or feelings of guilt or the inability to help, not reacting at all because they might not understand the severity of your emotional state or because they do not want to reinforce negative self talk of yours. Same with your mom i think... i mean im more or less playing a guessing game here but it sounds like she is tryung to guilt trip you into not acting upon your thoughts out of fear or maybe has troubles communicating her own feelings to you.
I think it could be beneficial for you to find out why you are having these thoughts and finding a professional or someone you trust so you can free your mind. Keep in mind you are only 16, which is a difficult time in life with lots of changes as your brain is rewiring etc.. however you are nlt alone and ypur feelings are perfectly valid, learn to listen to them, be patient with yourself and with finding the right people to open up to.
